why: Uses per battle: eachOnce gives Combat Doctrines (nerf-when, Assault Brethren) ASSAULT DOCTRINE 2 boxes and DEVASTATOR / TACTICAL DOCTRINE 1 each (rendered: r:Combat Doctrines:ASSAULT DOCTRINE#0/#1, …). That matches Wahapedia: 'You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle' and Assault Mastery 'You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle'. Kindred Sorcery (pubstomper) keeps its 3 single boxes under the same keys as before (r:Kindred Sorcery:<row>#0). Over every text in data.js, EACH_ONCE matches only Kindred Sorcery and Combat Doctrines, and the 'additional time' regex matches only Assault Mastery. It does not match Blessings of Khorne ('once per battle round'). abLine now names abilities by abOwner. Changed Overview lines are right: Strategium Command · Wardens of Ultramar (Wahapedia: a Wardens of Ultramar ability, not Calgar's). The only orphaned stored tick is the old single 'r:Combat Doctrines#0' box. It is harmless: it stays in storage, the user re-ticks, and New game clears it.

Combat Doctrines options are now listed under Command · Your turn › Once per battle. Their boxes are the Overview's own data-tick keys (checked in a headless render: identical keys and counts, Assault 2, others 1), so ticks stay in sync. Devastator Doctrine has left Active now, as the owner's rule asks. Assault and Tactical (a:1) appear only through their boxes. Every changed snapshot line was checked against data.js and Wahapedia. Owners by ab.who: Icon of Khorne → Khorne Berzerkers (Berzerkers wargear); Hunters from the Warp → Flesh Hounds; Crude Surgery → Painboy; Raise the Banner → Wardens of Ultramar; Thievin' Scavengers → Gretchin. Copy counts: Infractors×2 (Lord Exultant+Infractors, copies 2; NR prints the Icon of Excess on one Infractor in each) and Tormentors×2 (copies 2, ability printed by NR; unplaced). Also: Gretchin×4 in ooga-booga (Zodgrod's Gretchin 1 + Gretchin copies 3), Painboy×2 (Big Mek+Nobz+Painboy copies 2), Rendmaster on Blood Throne×2 (copies 2, 2 boxes labelled Unit 1/2), Flesh Hounds×2 in big-demons-baby (copies 2), and Knight Ruinator / Norn lines (separate units, only the pill format changed). Old single ticks on lines that now have N boxes (key k → k#i) are lost. These are per-phase reminders that Reset clears, so the loss is harmless. abOwner was checked on all 193 abilities of attached units in every list. Each has a who naming a real part, with no duplicate name+text across parts. Upgrades and enhancements name their holder (Extra Sneaky → Gretchin, Bane-Forged Weapons → Bloodletters, Brazenmaw → Skullmaster), so the Find index has no wrong part. Minor, not wrong: the Overview and Find count units (unitNames) while the checklist counts copies (unitNamesX), so the same ability can read 'Bloodletters ×2' in one and a different ×N in the other. Also, forced(o.f) still runs for each-once options, but no such option has an f today.
